description.value: The Hoodoos are a natural geological formation within Yoho National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site straddling the western slopes of the Canadian Rockies near Field, BC. These distinctive erosion pillars are a compelling roadside attraction for cyclists riding the Trans-Canada Highway corridor through the park. The surrounding landscape features glaciers, waterfalls, and world-renowned Burgess Shale fossil sites, making this stretch a highlight of any Rocky Mountain touring route.
